title: combineGating reads a runnable item with no evidence as demonstrated when the oracle observed nothing
body: When every runnable item's command fails to run (runner error, timeout or killed command, code<0), Oracle.Observe returns nil, and combineGating's observed==nil branch (internal/reconcile/absorb.go:530-534) returns the prediction as it stands. That prediction only covered UNVERIFIED items. A done [A1 runnable, A2 unverified] where A1 could not run and the classifier says none becomes NOT GATING and goes to the backlog, which is the false negative gvc exists to prevent. Confirmed with the real Oracle, Predictor and combineGating. TestCombineGatingAnswersEveryTierState's last case (absorb_test.go:767) asserts the bug. Fix: in that branch, fall back to absorbing whenever a Runnable item exists and the prediction is not gating.
